decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing creatures as a toolbox to combo off and win the game. It aims to have a versatile range of creatures that can be searched for and played using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The key strategy is to have Yawgmoth, Thran Physician on the battlefield to sacrifice creatures for card advantage and to control the board. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Blood Artist to gain value from sacrificing creatures, while also having some removal options with Walking Ballista and Endurance.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, powerful planeswalkers, and versatile creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage through card draw and extra turns with cards like Time Warp. The mana base is carefully constructed to allow for easy access to all colors needed for the spells in the deck. Leyline Binding and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provide additional control elements, while The One Ring and Up the Beanstalk serve as win conditions.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around controlling the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers, versatile removal spells, and efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt opponents' strategies, along with cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding to remove threats, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provide ways to close out games once the deck has established dominance.

The deck focuses on utilizing various control elements, such as counterspells and removal, to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also ramping into powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes a toolbox approach with cards like Bring to Light to search for specific answers or threats as needed. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a diverse range of colors, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. Ultimately, the key concept is to outvalue the opponent through efficient control and powerful late-game threats.

The deck revolves around using Cycling creatures like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Striped Riverwinder to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Violent Outburst or Living End to bring back powerful creatures like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries for a huge swing in momentum. The use of Force of Negation helps protect the combo from disruption, while cards like Waker of Waves and Grief provide additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board state created by quickly cycling and reanimating creatures.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively pressure the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, while using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to establish early board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while utilizing removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Undying Evil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and resilience to the deck's threats, allowing it to continue applying pressure and closing out games quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, aiming to deal damage efficiently and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It combines cheap, powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board and keep the pressure on. The deck also utilizes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand and prevent them from stabilizing. The key strategy is to maintain tempo and pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, planeswalkers, and versatile creatures such as Omnath, Locus of Creation. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, generate value through card advantage, and eventually win the game with powerful threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes time manipulation cards like Time Warp to further manipulate the game's tempo and swing it in the player's favor. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantages.

The main concept of this deck is to use equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly power up creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Inkmoth Nexus. By combining tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga with low-cost artifacts, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with powerful, fast attacks. The inclusion of cards like Giver of Runes and Shadowspear provide added protection and utility to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of powerful spells and lands. By ramping up mana quickly and utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the player can control the pace of the game and disrupt their opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Scapeshift to generate powerful combos and finish the game quickly. The key concept is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through efficient control and powerful win conditions.

This deck focuses on aggressively using human creatures to quickly overpower and overwhelm opponents. The key strategy involves playing powerful and efficient human creatures such as Mantis Rider, Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, and Champion of the Parish. Aether Vial is included to quickly put creatures onto the battlefield while Thalia's Lieutenant and Noble Hierarch provide additional benefits and buffs to the human squad. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Reflector Mage to disrupt opponents' plans. Finally, the inclusion of lands like Cavern of Souls and Unclaimed Territory helps ensure that the human creatures can be easily cast.

This deck focuses on using cards like Hardened Scales, Hangarback Walker, and Walking Ballista to quickly build up a huge army of creatures with +1/+1 counters. By maximizing the number of counters placed on each creature, the deck can overwhelm opponents with massive threats that are difficult to deal with. The inclusion of cards like Arcbound Ravager and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp also helps to protect and enhance the counters on creatures, making them even more dangerous. The deck aims to be aggressive and put pressure on opponents early in the game, quickly taking control of the board.

This deck focuses on utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to stall the game with counterspells like Counterspell and Supreme Verdict, while generating card advantage with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Eternal Witness. The deck also has a subtheme of ramping and fixing colors with cards like Bring to Light and Wrenn and Six to cast powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. Ultimately, the key strategy is to control the game until you can overwhelm the opponent with your powerful cards.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements, powerful planeswalkers, and versatile removal spells to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. By combining powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation with support cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. With a variety of lands and removal spells, the deck is able to adapt to different threats and matchups, ensuring consistency and flexibility in gameplay.

This aggressive deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to control the board and deal damage quickly, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, backed up by versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial. With the ability to cast Tribal Flames for extra damage based on land types, this deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent and finish them off before they can stabilize.

This deck revolves around the combo of Heliod, Sun-Crowned and Spike Feeder to generate infinite life gain and create a large, indestructible creature. The deck also includes cards like Auriok Champion and Conclave Mentor, which provide additional benefits when creatures enter the battlefield with +1/+1 counters. The deck aims to use cards like Collected Company and Ranger-Captain of Eos to search for and assemble the combo pieces quickly. It includes some mana acceleration cards like Utopia Sprawl and Horizon Canopy for consistency and card draw. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo and generating a strong board presence.
